name: io.github.fxams/crewpay-mcp
title: CREW / CrewPay
description: CrewPay MCP: Pump.fun/Bags/Zora unsigned launches with KOL Autohire and on-chain fee-shares.

headers.name: x-crew-api-key
headers.description: crew_ak_… from crew_claim_key / POST /api/agent/keys/claim (required for writes). Hosted MCP is publicMode and cannot hold a launcher secret.

environmentVariables.name: CREW_AGENT_API_KEY
environmentVariables.description: crew_ak_… from crew_claim_key / POST /api/agent/keys/claim, or operator key

environmentVariables.name: CREW_LAUNCHER_KEY
environmentVariables.description: Dedicated low-SOL burner Solana secret for launch/wire/lock (local env only — never a tool arg). Not used by hosted remote.

environmentVariables.name: CREWPAY_REFERRAL_CODE
environmentVariables.description: Optional KOL referral code used by crew_claim_key when referral_code arg omitted

environmentVariables.name: X402_EVM_PRIVATE_KEY
environmentVariables.description: Optional hex private key for Base USDC x402 pay-per-call (alternative to CREW_AGENT_API_KEY). Local env only — never a tool arg. Not used by hosted remote.
